【原视频简介】
Moje biurko E7 Plus od FlexiSpot - https://bit.ly/4jnyQiL
Oferty FlexiSpot - https://bit.ly/4lhZJ9D

In this video I grow opals in my parent's garage by experiencing hell with silicon tetrachloride, making TEOS, and playing Sherlock Holmes to find a good procedure for opal production while synthesizing rare tar and having my Dad build me a cute little centrifuge.

If you enjoyed the video consider liking it, sharing it with a friend, and subscribing to my channel - I would really appreciate that :)

If you want to further support my work and watch exclusive content here's my Patreon - https://www.patreon.com/AmateurChemistry

Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/amateur_chemistry/
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@amateurchemistry/
Twitter (X) - https://x.com/AmateurChemist_

Here's the main paper I reference throughout the video - https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11051-016-3691-8.pdf

Also, excuse me for my poor speaking, English is not my native language so I have some trouble with pronunciation, in case you don't understand something there are always subtitles made by me.

0:00 Intro
5:39 Making TEOS (Tetraethyl orthosilicate)
21:23 Figuring out how to make silica nanospheres and opal
34:21 Making dirt opals for real this time
40:50 Upgrading the opals using alcohol
48:10 Outro
